dog.description_text:
Meet Benicio, a handsome boy whose friends describe him as a happy guy!

Benicio has a fun-loving personality and enjoys making the most of his day with toys, treats and time spent with his favorite people. This handsome guy already knows how to sit, and it is the fanciest sit you’ll ever see! He leans into pets from all his friends. Toys and yummy treats are always welcome, making it easy to keep this happy guy entertained!

If you're looking for a cheerful companion with a playful personality, a fancy sit and lots of happiness to share, Benicio is ready to meet you! Click the “Adopt Me” button to find out more about him.

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: BENICIO
